remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in the Village of Barker, offering space, functionality, and timeless character throughout! A large double-wide blacktop driveway provides ample parking and leads to the impressive 3-bay garage complete with electrical service, perfect for vehicles, hobbies, or workshop space. Outside, enjoy a partially fenced yard along with an additional storage shed for all your outdoor essentials. A spacious open front porch welcomes you inside to a versatile bonus room currently used as a second living area and office, offering endless possibilities to fit your lifestyle. The  spacious gourmet kitchen features an inviting open layout with beautiful brick accents surrounding the cooking area, generous counter space, abundant cabinetry, and a cozy eat-in nook. Just off the kitchen, you’ll find a bright and expansive living and dining area highlighted by a built-in fireplace and extra space perfect for a reading corner, play area, or sitting nook. A convenient first-floor full bath with washer and dryer adds everyday practicality. Upstairs, the home offers three large, spacious bedrooms along with a second full bathroom. The full attic provides exceptional storage space and potential for future expansion, whether as an additional bedroom, office, or flex space. This Village of Barker home combines charm, space, and versatility, a wonderful opportunity you won’t want to miss!
